title: Pattern is a Prime Agent whose mandate is supplying on-chain liquidity to both on-chain and off-chain credit opportunities
content:
A.6.1.1.6.1 states the mandate in one sentence: "Pattern is an Agent providing on-chain liquidity to on-chain and off-chain credit opportunities. Pattern will support new Halo projects focused on both traditional credit and decentralized lending."

A.6.1.1.6.2.1.2.3.1.1.1 fixes its class: "Pattern is a Prime Agent." In Sky's taxonomy that matters because Prime Agents hold their own token, governance and capital, as opposed to Executor Agents which supply operational execution to others.

Two things make the mandate load-bearing rather than decorative. First, the deliberate inclusion of **off-chain** credit means the Agent's asset side is exposed to legal and counterparty risk that no on-chain mechanism can liquidate — a different risk class from purely on-chain lending. Second, the commitment to "support new Halo projects" makes Pattern a launch platform, not just a lender: its function is to originate credit programs rather than to allocate into existing ones.

Everything downstream in the Pattern Artifact — the Primitives it activates, the Executor Accord it enters, the capital it holds — is instrumentation for this one mandate, and a change of mandate would invalidate that configuration.
description: Its remit spans decentralized lending and traditional credit through new Halo projects, positioning it as a bridge between crypto-native liquidity and off-chain borrowers.
